title: Concrete World #3759
description: A surreal fantasy scene features a giant multicolored serpent coiled around a large glass bottle containing a glowing tree with blue fruit. The bottle is labeled "CONCRETE WORLD #3759" and topped with blooming pink roses and lightning. In the foreground, a robed wizard holds a sign with the number 2 while looking at the serpent, which breathes orange energy toward floating portrait bubbles. A large smiling crescent moon and aurora borealis dominate the purple night sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene set in a cracked purple desert landscape under a large smiling crescent moon and vibrant green aurora.
